::: {.content-visible when-profile="id"}
Rincian lengkap Proyek Tengah Semester (tema, aturan, tahapan, rubrik penilaian) untuk Semester Gasal 2026/2027 akan diunggah di halaman ini menyusul, mengikuti jadwal berikut:

- **Guideline dirilis:** Minggu 3 (7-11 September)
- **Checkpoint 1** (Project Ideas, Project Initiation): Minggu 4 (16 September)
- **Checkpoint 2** (Design System, 1st Deployment): Minggu 6 (28 September - 2 Oktober)
- **Deadline akhir:** Minggu 9 (19-23 Oktober)

Lihat halaman **Jadwal** untuk detail tanggal terbaru.
:::
::: {.content-visible when-profile="en"}
Full details for the Mid-Term Group Project (theme, rules, stages, grading rubric) for Odd Semester 2026/2027 will be uploaded to this page later, following this schedule:

- **Guideline released:** Week 3 (Sep 7-11)
- **Checkpoint 1** (Project Ideas, Project Initiation): Week 4 (Sep 16)
- **Checkpoint 2** (Design System, 1st Deployment): Week 6 (Sep 28 - Oct 2)
- **Final deadline:** Week 9 (Oct 19-23)

See the **Schedule** page for the latest dates.
:::
